horoscopes.horoscope: Today will be a very romantic day for you. Ganesha says you will be faced with many temptations and you may forget that your wishes are not being reciprocated. If your relationships are in troubled waters, you will get some hints about pending matters. You may not devote much time to your beloved. You can surprise your sweetheart by making sketches of things he/she really loves or presenting a sweet gift close to his/her heart. Managing emotional stress will be comfortable for you, says Ganesha. Today, you may not be in a great mood or health. Still, at the beginning of the day, health looks okay to Ganesha. As the day progresses, chances of deterioration in your health would increase. You will be dealing with pending activities today. During first half of the day today, you are most likely to have your focus on expenses that may not be essential for now. You will be spending money on your prestige and dear ones today. An average day on the professional front, says Ganesha. Mundane tasks may consume a lot of time and energy, despite that your concern for quality work will remain high. Later in the day, you may be worried about pending work as you are supposed to get more tasks to finish on time.

There is a good chance that you will be able to make changes at your workplace that you had desired since a long time. You will be generous with gifts and favours, which will go down well with your loved ones (though not with your bank balance!). You will win favours from the opposite sex later in the day, says Ganesha. At the same time, you will be concerned about your love life. So you may want to leave the office at the very first opportunity. You want to take a cautious approach when it comes to the matter of the heart, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you may not be very clear about which way to go. You will have to work harder in various areas of life, due to which you may feel tired and worked up as the day progresses. Ganesha feels that today you are going to do excellent job by tapping contacts who can provide you with loans. You may not be in dire need of money but may still wish to have extra money. You will be tensed at the start of the day. You will have a lot of work piled up on your desk and you will have to sweat it out at work, irrespective of the temperature outside. As the day progresses, you may feel worked out and tired.

You will break free of your routine work today and spend the day having fun with your family and friends. Plans for dinner or for a picnic with your loved ones are strongly indicated, and should see you filled with enthusiasm. Waiting for a couple of days before proposing to that special someone should net you a favourable response, says Ganesha. Love life may be monotonous as things will get repetitive in daily life, foresees Ganesha. You may plan to do something new and your sweetheart is also likely to support you. However, you may spend the time at home doing some domestic activities. Your mind will stay busy but that won’t impact your health. Your brain cells though will be used to the optimum, body will not be affected adversely, which is the best part of the day. It is a good day to learn new things. If you are looking forward to play lotto or try your luck in card games in the evening, Ganesha shows you red signal. It’s not a good idea because your luck is turning off for fiscal matters. You have been wrecking your head over a few problems for quite a while now. If you don’t lose hope, everything will fall into place. You should stop thinking about the troubles in your life. However, you need to do keep a track of things happening around you.

You will be an eternal optimist today. Ganesha says that your accomplishments will motivate others to emulate you. You will spend the evening with family members and enjoy it, too. your value for family values and plans will go up to-day. You will follow a definite pattern in achieving them. Understanding your partner’s feelings will create a better understanding between the two of you, says Ganesha.You may take your partner to shopping where both of you are likely to spend time. A sweet discussion at the poolside lounge would also be a good idea. Some good achievement will give you sense of satisfaction. There will be positive changes in your thinking process. You will be able to impart your knowledge to others. All these things will make you happy and will also impact your health positively. If you are willing to let your apartment or office on a long-term rent, this is going to be a favourable day. You should basically be able to earn through your real-estate investments. Ganesha observes that you will waste precious moments on pointless debates and conversations. This may also lead to frustration. However, you need to exercise a little patience. You should focus on the important projects. Things will take a turn for the good after lunch, feels Ganesha.

You will take some progressive decisions in the morning. However, your positivity will fade away as the day progresses and you will take a pessimistic view of things. This could affect your decisions. You will accomplish more in the later half of the day, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow Ganesha says, your love life will be on a roll today. Lovers will be in an adventurous mood and may go out to some unusual destination. You will chill out the day with your near and dear one and enjoy whatever you like to do. You will not be very happy with what is happening in your surroundings. This could make you puzzled and stressed. Your confidence may be affected today. Ganesha suggests you to avoid over-thinking to avoid stress and also to maintain good health. You may not be interested in going in details of money earned and money spent. This doesn’t mean that you have laid back attitude towards money, but this means that you are really very busy. A busy day is ahead of you. You will be on your toes for the entire day. You will remain occupied with work and there’s not much you can do about it. You will pay more attention to getting a better result. Decision making on the major activities would be on your agenda.

Ganesha predicts that you will achieve the targets that you set out to achieve today. The heavy pressure of work will not affect you in any way. Ganesha says the secret of your success is being patient. You are bang on target. The difference of opinions is likely to be on the cards. You may not be satisfied with the way your relationship is going, feels Ganesha. However, you need to avoid examining your beloved as too much of criticism may hurt his/her feelings, warns Ganesha. While you may be more relaxed in the early part of the day, your mood may become better later. You will be completely happy only by the time day gets over. Although health does not look very bad today, the day doesn’t indicate anything drastic. You will be happy with what you have been able to accumulate till date and what you are likely to accumulate in the future will also look promising. This is going to add delight to your life. You may be very vocal at the office today. You may offer suggestions to all those around you. Make sure the rejection of your viewpoint by the senior members does not upset you. Be attentive at work and finish it as per schedule, suggests Ganesha.

Ganesha says you will see your hard work come to fruition today. This is a good and profitable day for all those of you who are associated with the business field. For those of you who are working professionals this will be a day when your senior officials will praise you for taking up tough tasks and completing them satisfactorily. Ganesha advises you to avoid arguments today. You are likely to be completely exhausted by the evening. However, this evening will be full of romance as your beloved knows what excites you. You are ready to receive all the sensual pleasure that will satisfy your heart. A happy and harmonious period is on the cards. It’s a good day for you. You will not feel tired or drained. Your enthusiasm level will be maintained. Although you will be slightly less confident, you will appear to be confident. On the whole, it’s a good day from health point of view. There won’t be financial imbalance from any angle. As day progresses, you will find it to be more and more promising for money matters. This is a good day to spend money on looks and apparels. Ganesha foresees physically and mentally a challenging day ahead. You will need to do the relaxation before the day begins and after it ends. However, it’s not just work that will keep you occupied. There is a lot of socialising and networking involved.

Keep as much distance as possible from partnerships and JVs, advises Ganesha. At work, your experience will be enough to manage huge projects. Today you are set to emerge as a better manager of large pools of people, and guide them on the lines of your imagination and decisiveness. You need to pay attention to your personal life. If you get bored in the relationship, you can discuss with your sweetheart to find out some exciting solutions or may keep experimenting activities that suit his/her interest, says Ganesha. Life will be less complicated. While you may not be in good mood in the early part of the day, Ganesha foresees later positive change in your mental and physical condition and you will be dealing with everything very well. You may also become bit health conscious and proactive. This may make you worry a bit about nearer and distant future from financial standpoint but don’t worry, things will be back in control during the second half of the day. You will be energetic and full of excitement throughout the day. Ganesha notes that you will experience a strong ardor to excel in all spheres of life. Being hasty may pose a few problems. You should do a thorough analysis before submitting a project, suggests Ganesha.

Your role in bringing crucial and influential deals will be pivotal, says Ganesha. However, the end results may not turn up as per your expectations. But a pleasant evening with your beloved is likely to cheer you up and lighten your mood. A good time to spend with family and friends. You may receive an invitation from your sweetheart to attend a social party. Time to enjoy a colorful day with your friends and beloved. You may not get the much-needed time for romance. Today you need more relaxed time in solitude. Yo should also avoid negative communication.Lot of communication with others may also make you feel tired where as communicating with ‘inner self’ is more necessary for you today, feels Ganesha. You should find time for yourself. Ganesha feels that while first half of the day is going to shower blessings of coins in your pocket, second half of the day can be very tricky especially for a spendthrift like you. An uneventful day ahead. The day may not bore you at least in the morning as you are likely to pick up your energy and confidence, says Ganesha. Your performance will be at its peak at work, and deadlines will be met. The evening will be average as you may not find any activity.

You are in for a windfall, predicts Ganesha. Patience is the key for you. Your patience and composure will enable you to put yourself in others’ shoes and understand their problems. If you’re a student or planning to enrol yourself for a course, Ganesha ensures tremendous growth for you in that direction. You need to dedicate some time to your beloved who may be feeling a little neglected. Your love life may come under a thorough scrutiny and you will need to adjust to get settled. Spending a quality time with your beloved seems to be a challenge, feels Ganesha. The day will begin with lot of energy and enthusiasm. Ganesha suggests you to avoid ignoring others, as it might hurt them, which may upset you in return. Though health wise it is a good day, it might bring some emotional fluctuations. Don’t over-commit and don’t under-commit. Today, you will have to remain balanced in your professional or business commitments in order to enhance your financial prospects. Professional and personal life both demand undivided attention today. You will feel the heat and will struggle between the unfair demands of both. However, being practical, planning and scheduling things properly will solve most of your problems. You are likely to invest time and energy in the most urgent matters.

The wanderer in you has suddenly come alive. You scan through travel magazines, surf internet and probably go on a tracking tour or just randomly go to distant places all by yourself. Take some of your close friends or like minded people along with and double the fun, suggests Ganesha. Romance is in the air and you will thoroughly enjoy yourself in every aspect. You want to spend the time out of your home and may take part in some adventurous activities. You will get emotional support from your partner. Live the moment to its fullest, advises Ganesha. You don’t face any health problem today, says Ganesha. But there could be issues on the emotional front. Your constant efforts to convince others and think about them may make you tired. You may feel you were very occupied. You need relaxation of nerves. Ganesha strongly feels that because of your positive approach and logical abilities, today you will be able to go further from where you have been. Ganesha feels that you should worship Goddess Lakshmi. You will have a fabulous day. Progress and an amazing sense of fulfillment await you. You will succeed as well as excel in everything that you take up today. You will feel spontaneous and keep a healthy relationship with people in the workplace.

It is best that you concentrate single-mindedly on the task at hand at the work-place, rather than diverting your attention to other things, if you want to meet all your deadlines today, says Ganesha. Compromising on certain issues in relationships will only help you, and is the best way to maintain the balance in your personal life. You will be motivated to enhance your skills and apply them to your personal life. Ganesha finds you in a lively mood all through the day. Planning and organising things in domestic work may bore you. You are likely to spend time by making a movie in a peaceful surrounding with your sweetheart. You may experience mood swings today. Your health may also be average in the early part of day but post lunch time, Ganesha does foresee improvement in health, however not in mood. Today you should do something creative, that gives you sense of satisfaction. You will realise that time is money and wasted time is wasted money. You will start working on long term projects or assignments today. During first half of the day, stars are not in your favour for financial matters. You will be able to avail new opportunities to expand your knowledge and familiarize yourself with innovative things. You are required to keep updated information in the workplace and may need to go fast. You may remain crazy but Ganesha says you should remain practical in order to achieve results.
